top_signals.title: Asia markets edge higher as investors assess fresh U.S. tariffs; South Korea rate decision in focus
top_signals.summary: Asia-Pacific markets edged higher on Thursday as concerns over artificial intelligence spending, sticky inflation and new U.S. tariffs weigh on investor sentiment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
